artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal clasp on the left edge appears physically nonsensical. It floats slightly off the edge, lacks a clear connection point or hinge, and the geometry of the metal piece is ambiguous and malformed compared to real-world binder clasps.

The divider tabs protruding from the spine appear to merge into the spine rather than sitting between pages. The perspective of the tabs is inconsistent, with some appearing flat and others angled oddly without clear separation.
The background texture is overly uniform and repetitive, lacking the natural variation of wood or fabric, suggesting a generated pattern.

To assess overall visual coherence and detect subtle rendering artifacts in textures and lighting.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the metal clasp on the left; it appears to be a common AI artifact where functional mechanical parts are rendered as vague metallic blobs without proper hinges or attachment points. Also, inspect the divider tabs on the right to ensure they are distinct entities and not melting into the spine.
